verdict.rationale: iTerm2 provides a documented Python API for controlling the app (open windows/sessions, send text, query state) and a full AppleScript scripting interface, corroborated by hands-on community praise calling it 'basically AppleScript for iTerm except it lets you touch pretty much everything.' missing for 10: no evidence of a formal socket/JSON-RPC IPC spec doc beyond the Python API wrapper, and no independent report of scripting reliability at scale.
